sampleRepresentation: signed int32 microunit samples; identical canonical samples supplied to both methods

methods.algorithm: one vertex per active cell; finite-difference gradients; regularized least-squares QEF; cell-clamped vertices; quad output triangulated on diagonal 0-2 for shared topology checks

limitations: The DC implementation is a simple Python finite-difference/QEF reference, not the SIGGRAPH 2026 discrete-SDF dual-contouring method.
Timing is not a fair algorithm-performance comparison: scikit-image marching cubes is compiled while the QEF reference uses Python loops.
Only one timing observation per method was recorded for this initial cross-method probe.
Residual is evaluated against the same approximate continuous field, not exact Euclidean geometry.
Trimesh topology diagnostics do not establish absence of self-intersections.
Dual-contouring quads were triangulated on a fixed diagonal only for common Trimesh topology checks.
No production Rust, GPU or blinded perceptual qualification.
